root.label: ProPublica investigation of Idaho faith-healing child deaths

events.label: ProPublica investigation of Idaho faith-healing child deaths

slots.name: preventable deaths
slots.sentence: At least 15 babies and children from the faith-healing sect died between 2015 and 2025 from illnesses that doctors could have successfully treated, the experts concluded.

slots.name: unevaluated deaths
slots.sentence: The experts could not evaluate six more deaths because coroner records were incomplete or unavailable.

slots.name: uncertain cases
slots.sentence: In another four cases, they couldn’t say with confidence whether medical care would have changed the outcome.

slots.name: deaths followed
slots.sentence: Canyon County Sheriff Kieran Donahue, one of the most vocal opponents of Idaho’s faith-healing laws, has sent deputies to follow up on the deaths of at least 10 Followers’ children and infants since he took office in 2013.

slots.name: reviewed deaths
slots.sentence: David Peterman, a retired Idaho pediatrician, reviewed the deaths of 18 infants and children at ProPublica’s request.

slots.name: sepsis deaths
slots.sentence: At least three children died from sepsis caused by common infections that antibiotics can easily stop.

slots.name: multiple-loss parents
slots.sentence: Records show at least five sets of parents have lost multiple children, a phenomenon that has not previously been reported.

slots.name: Kangas grandchildren deaths
slots.sentence: Kangas lost his own wife and their last child during labor 23 years ago. Three of his 65 grandchildren also have died.

slots.name: infant pneumonia death rate
slots.sentence: The annual pneumonia-related death rate in the U.S. for infants is 1 in every 30,000 to 40,000, according to federal data.

slots.name: family death rate
slots.sentence: Adrian wrote that with a total of 12 children in Malachi and Liam’s family, the death rate was 1 in 6, “equivalent to third-world countries.”
